title: Actor/STATUS binding writers and current-player parking
decision: Five STATUS entry observers do not encompass native Actor-to-STATUS rebinding. Keep the new STATUS runtime uninstalled and Journal admission unavailable until binding mutation and Actor lifetime synchronization have their own supported proof.

findings.summary: Releases old Actor+0x5c0 through 3C07E0 if non-null, calls 3C06B0, stores the returned STATUS pointer into Actor+0x5c0, then stores EncodeNullable(Actor) into STATUS+0x268 if non-null.
findings.boundary: The Release observer has already returned before the later binding stores. In 3C06B0, a cache-hit path increments +0x264 at 3C07CA and returns without Init/Rebuild. Thus a five-writer inFlight counter alone does not cover the outer rebinding interval.

findings.summary: Releases old Actor+0x5c0, calls 3C0280 to allocate/initialize enemy STATUS, writes the Actor pointer slot, then encodes the Actor into the new STATUS backlink.
findings.boundary: Observed initialization returns before the pointer/backlink stores.

findings.summary: Publishes the current-player global before fetching STATUS via 3C0620 and before writing the Actor slot and encoded STATUS backlink. Reading the global alone does not establish completion of this constructor.

After the common 3D5840 construction path, obtains STATUS via 3C02E0 and writes Actor+0x5c0 plus encoded STATUS+0x268. These stores occur after the observed STATUS rebuild/initialization routines return.
findings.limit: Exact playable role is not established by this census.

findings.summary: Known common Actor initialization clears its +0x5c0 slot with zeroed, preserved R14. Full body is included.
STATUS initialization stores the null EncodeNullable result in +0x268. This known writer is inside the existing Initialize observer root.
3A80E0 moves CurrentPlayer to global 2A11268 and clears CurrentPlayer. 3A8140 copies that parked pointer back and clears 2A11268. OffCurrent is therefore not positive retirement evidence.
findings.limit: The two exported bodies prove parking/restoration; transitive callees and concurrent lifetime exclusion are not established here.

findings.summary: These five direct stores are present in the recorded 186 direct IDA xrefs to CurrentPlayer; all xref instructions are independently decoded from original PE bytes.
findings.limit: Does not exclude writes through computed aliases, bulk copies or unknown code.

findings.summary: The same +0x5c0 displacement occurs in WINDOW_BASE construction. The explicit WINDOW_BASE vtable assignment and WIN_SEQ member construction establish a different object role.
These routines allocate and construct WINDOW_BALLOON objects, then store those window pointers at receiver+0x5c0.
findings.limit: Their receiving object's role is not closed here. They are not counted as confirmed Actor STATUS writers merely because the displacement matches.

text_search.pagination: All 88 returned done=true, no cancellation or page truncation. This is complete requested range traversal, not complete rendered-instruction coverage.

direct_xrefs.pagination: All recorded xref sets have next_offset=null and matching counts.

supplement.method: Four-byte positive displacement encodings for +0x5c0..+0x5c7 and +0x268..+0x26b. Every executable pattern position has a bounded instruction-head window; every window reports done with no truncation. Bytepatterns and all confirmed function bodies are compared with the original PE.

coverage.machine_classification: instruction-candidates.json records Capstone-decoded operands and bytes. Memory displacement is only a candidate; RBP may itself be a frame pointer. Object roles remain unclassified except findings justified by full bodies.

tool_limits: insn_query op_any=1472 or 616 misses the known stores at 3A7B1B/3A7B32. Local api_analysis.py uses op.value for o_displ instead of op.addr. This failed known-answer probe is recorded and never used to exclude writers.

search_text can omit the instruction line behind labels/comments. Four of the 186 CurrentPlayer xrefs were absent: 3A3351,3BE404,3CF9B2,3FE548. Unfiltered insn_query recovered all four; they are loads, not new direct stores.

insn_query may include a requested start inside an existing instruction while rendering that containing instruction's text. The byte-window classifier discards every row exactly at a window start. The containing four-byte displacement cannot begin in an instruction 15 bytes earlier. Full verified body rows remain the source for claimed writers.
An initial get_bytes request for 732 regions returned ten without pagination. All 732 were rerequested in batches of ten with exact response-count validation.

The rendered-text and exact positive-displacement search does not exclude typed/renamed operands, undiscovered code, base-biased or computed aliases, wider writes starting before the field, indexed effective addresses, bulk copies, indirect writes or another object's coincident displacement.

next_work.need: Establish complete execution/thread provenance and a common exclusion interval across Release, allocator return, Actor slot store and backlink store. Five inner STATUS hooks are insufficient.
Resolve callers/transitive retirement behavior, retain parked generations and separate off-current from retirement.
Trace base register provenance and receiving object class before admitting or excluding candidates. The complete candidate list is preserved.
Use the parallel heap/bulk analysis plus construction/lifetime evidence; include writes starting before either field and base-adjusted destinations. No alias-closure claim is made here.

verification.checks: Original PE SHA; all full body bytes; every full ASM cursor/count/instruction boundary; contiguous text chunk requests; original bytes for 732 text hits and all bytepatterns; complete query windows; all 186 direct global references; specific store widths and rebind calls.
